item.description: ### Fixed - **The Cursor usage bar no longer disappears when you stop using Cursor.** It was the only usage bar that vanished after a quiet spell, and it was never there at all when Perch had just started — Claude's and Codex's stay put because their numbers are saved on this Mac, and now Cursor's are too. It still only refreshes while you're working, and the time on the right still turns orange to tell you when a reading is getting old. The bar clears when your billing period ends, since by then the percentage is about a month that's over.
